memory.content: Elefante customer installation contract: a release installer places one stable per-user runtime, uses one private data root and one loopback daemon, and verifies user-level registration for every detected compatible IDE or CLI agent. A customer install must fail if any detected compatible host is uncovered. A source checkout is developer scope and must not replace the customer runtime.

lifecycle_review.basis: The project owner explicitly reaffirmed one global customer runtime across supported tools and required uncovered compatible hosts to fail customer readiness. The durable store remains unchanged; this adjudication applies only to the sealed calibration fixture.
